new_result.interpretation: The preregistered public-recovery runner independently recovered authoritative derived H10S calibration material and processing provenance, but not the underlying H10S calibration-sequence sample bytes, machine-readable numeric response table, or actual calibration timestamp table. Public non-recovery is not custodian absence.

reasons.COUSTEAU_HA10_PRE_POST_2013_CROSSTALK_TR: The exact frozen 2013 EarthScope six-channel waveform gate already returned 240/240 HTTP 404 no-data requests. No access-condition change is known.
reasons.COUSTEAU_HA10_CALIBRATION_SEQUENCE_PUBLI: The independently preregistered 60-resource public recovery pass completed successfully. Repeating it without a new source/access condition would not add independent evidence.

whole_picture_so_far.fact_1: CTBTO material documents an H10S1 electrical-noise event on 2013-07-19 that evolved into persistent noise with time-variable cross-talk into H10S2/H10S3; H10S1 was excluded from IDC Operations. Possible riser failure remains an interpretation, not a proven mechanism.
whole_picture_so_far.fact_2: The deployed UWS calibration sequence tests digitizer electronics while excluding hydrophone ceramic, preamplifier and riser cable. Public material states the calibration data are stored at the CTBTO IDC and processed from known injected sequences.
whole_picture_so_far.fact_3: The preregistered recovery gate recovered derived H10S fault-era calibration results and all targeted historical fact flags, but did not recover raw sequence bytes or machine-readable numeric/timestamp data in 60 bounded public resources.
whole_picture_so_far.fact_4: EarthScope public StationXML does not encode the documented 2013 fault-era calibration history: all six EDH channels expose one static 2004-open response epoch in the JANUS audit.
whole_picture_so_far.fact_5: The direct six-channel 2013 waveform discriminator is archive-blocked on the tested EarthScope route: 240/240 frozen requests returned no data while response metadata exist.
whole_picture_so_far.fact_6: JANUS 2014-2015 public waveforms repeatedly show an approximately 12-13 dB broadband H10S2-over-H10N1 excess. Public StationXML response correction changes the ratio only by tenths of a dB and does not collapse it.
whole_picture_so_far.fact_7: Published 2013 H10S transfer-function differences and the later 12-13 dB cross-station broadband power offset are different statistics and cannot be substituted as a one-to-one explanation.
whole_picture_so_far.fact_8: Separate literature reports H10 data-logger electronic artefacts and spurious coherent zero-lag correlations before 2013, roughly 2005-2009. Therefore an earlier waveform baseline must not automatically be called instrument-clean.
whole_picture_so_far.fact_9: December 2014 supports a persistent scale-like S2/N1 baseline; January strict per-window scalar generalization fails at 18:00 and 06:00 while central medians remain near the baseline. Descriptively this is baseline plus episodic residuals.
whole_picture_so_far.fact_10: The physical geometry lane remains independent. PDC/01236 bounding geometry contains H10N1 but not H10S2; exact native swath/track crossing and morphology at the frozen points remain unresolved.
whole_picture_so_far.assistant_current_hypothesis: The strongest economical synthesis is MIXED_SUPERPOSITION: persistent site/trunk/propagation/seabed or analogue-path baseline + an H10S measurement-chain problem not represented by public StationXML + episodic residual contamination. Current evidence cannot yet partition those terms.
whole_picture_so_far.strongest_countermodel: The large baseline could primarily be persistent site/path physics with electronics adding only intermittent contamination; conversely an unmeasured analogue/riser effect could dominate the baseline. A new temporal availability axis or independent native geometry is needed.

available_next_discriminators.first_available_six_channel_baseline: Determine the earliest epoch where all six HA10 EDH public waveforms are simultaneously available using availability metadata/bounded discovery before inspecting waveform values; freeze windows, then compare baseline and coupling morphology.
available_next_discriminators.native_bathymetry_swath_intersection: Establish exact native multibeam/backscatter/swath crossing and physical morphology independently of hydrophone electronics.
available_next_discriminators.custodian_calibration_reply: Use authoritative EarthScope/CTBTO/IDC reply or controlled access to obtain calibration sequence bytes, calibration-event tables or raw historical waveforms.

question_to_janus: Attack the exact preregistered recovery receipt and this synthesis through all 17 JANUS reverse lenses. Choose exactly one next evidence gate. Respect the v3 progress guard, preserve independent bathymetry, and veto any 119-Hz reinterpretation.
